QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_73

question.text: According to the APY description, contributions are invested predominantly in which instruments?

answer.text: Government securities, term deposits and other debt securities
The subscriber chooses the asset class allocation

explanation.text: The Logic: The APY workbook description states that the subscriber has no investment choice and that contributions are invested predominantly in government securities, term deposits and other debt securities. The Trap: Wording such as "only" debt or "only" government securities is too strong, because the APY portfolio also has stated limits for the E and A categories. The defining points are (a) no subscriber investment choice and (b) predominantly debt/government instruments. Note: Keep the "no investment choice" point intact when summarising APY, and avoid framing the question as a broad choice of asset classes.
